phaseFacts: Treeification reassigns internal IDs in current node list order.
DFS marks1, recursively processes outgoing edges; only outer start becomes2. It is not textbook finishing-color DFS.
BFS marks1 at dequeue rather than enqueue; duplicates and resulting eliminated edge order must match source.
Eliminated edges are removed from node adjacency only, kept in graph.edges and REMOVABLE_EDGES; untreeify appends them back in recorded order.
RootProcessor finds zero-incoming nodes after treeification:0 addsDUMMY_ROOT,1 unchanged,more createsSUPER_ROOT withDUMMY edges.
TGraph node import center uses raw half-dimensions before clamping algorithm size to at least1.
Tree edge import calls hierarchy predicate twice and skips hierarchy/selfloop, using source-child encounter order and first target owner.
Full layout performs component splitting/packing, four phases, configured intermediates and micro-layout; these are not replaced by the first graph phases.
Radial findRoot returns first zero-incoming child; it does not independently prove all graph topology is a tree. No invented blanket non-tree rejection.

providerInterface.intended: _layout(state,node,monitor=None) with public-private clone convenience wrappers as E16
providerInterface.sharedState: same per-job _State and object identities; internal property bags separate from original layoutOptions
providerInterface.microLayoutDependency: Both providers default to NodeMicroLayout(ElkGraphAdapter); root/A generic raw-node adapter hook is required. Do not silently skip label/ports or infer text size.
providerInterface.sourcePhaseOnlyAPI: build_graph/treeify/find_roots/untreeify operate real native TGraph; no placeholder planar coordinates or backend execution

scope: No arbitrary graph size cap. Entire algorithm/applicable option goal stays pending until real phases and host integration are done. No full checks or old matrices.
placementFacts: FAN uses source string path IDs and per-prefix counts, not a substituted direct subtree-size calculation.

NodeOrderer stable ascending FAN/DESCENDANTS then consumes zero-valued trailing leaves; actual outgoing edge reorder is descending POSITION for these weights but ascending POSITION for CONSTRAINT. MODEL_ORDER does not reorder.
Constraint first pass compares against shrinking inBoundNodes size; preserve collisions and nearest plus-before-minus search.
NodePlacer defaults UNDEFINED to DOWN only after LevelHeight has already run; rounding is JS Math.round then Java long conversion then signed low32, not Python bankers round.
Neighbors start at roots children; dummy root IDs may collide with originals and LevelProcessor intentionally keys by internal id.
Direction and top-left conversion are distinct real intermediates. Later edge-routing/compaction/components/micro-layout remain pending.

numericAdapter.implementationKind: original Python host semantic adapter; not mechanical GWT BigLong port
numericAdapter.rounding: JS Math.round: compare x-floor(x) to0.5, ties toward positive infinity; do not floor(x+0.5)
numericAdapter.conversion: NaN0, infinities/out-of-range saturate signed64, then signed low32
numericAdapter.supportLicense: GWT support code exact license remains pending; no runtime source copied

routingComponentFacts: Component DFS appends incident edges repeatedly in source order; moving/packing distincts edges by identity. Do not globally deduplicate import adjacency.
Component pack first sorts descending summed priority then ascending area; normalization uses source GRAPH_XMIN/YMIN (not inferred padding-only translation).
Compaction begins and returns without done when disabled. Full constraints/multi-parent/level ascension branches remain a real target, not removed.
TreeUtil getAllIncoming/Outgoing filters level inequality and deduplicates by edge string representation, not identity; SUPER_ROOT sentinel is literal label-based.
Routing AVOID_OVERLAP has explicit direction-specific asymmetric arithmetic and cycle inducing side counters/gap observer mutation. Do not replace with a generic orthogonal router.
Full transfer computes reported bounds using tNode.pos +/- half size even after intermediate top-left conversion; preserve source arithmetic rather than correcting geometry intuition.
All public defaults still require generic real NodeMicroLayout from central host. Source proposal/phase-only is not full provider acceptance.

pipelineScheduleFacts: beforeP2 ROOT,FAN,LEVEL then NodeOrderer; beforeP3 NEIGHBORS,LEVEL_HEIGHT then NodePlacer; beforeP4 DIRECTION,NODE_POSITION,COMPACTION,LEVEL_COORDS,GRAPH_BOUNDS,UNTREEIFY then EdgeRouter.
afterP3 and beforeP4 share the same processor slot; AlgorithmAssembler distincts factories then sorts by enum ordinal. Do not restore eliminated adjacency before NodePosition walks.
Compaction precedes LevelCoordinates by ordinal despite declaration order in EdgeRouter config. Disabled compaction begins but returns without done.
radialMathFacts: Eades tau is literally2*acos(currentRadius/currentRadius+radius), often NaN; do not repair parenthesization or clamp acos domain. Host maps JS IEEE divide/acos NaN semantics.

getSuccessors retains duplicates in ordered ArrayList; it excludes source-port edges and targets that are direct containment children. First incoming tree-parent uses allIncomingEdges original first entry.
Wedge-by-node-size is max(sum(childSpace),ownDiagonal), leaves criteria recursively counts successors, no generic topology validation added.
Crossing optimizer literally computes rootY from root.x+root.width/2 and mutates original POSITION vectors while evaluating. Mutable native decoded property identity must persist.
HashSet topology helpers in overlap/compaction require real dependency investigation; do not assume universal insertion-order or reuse E09 fresh-edge-only observer proof.
Provider default micro hook remains mandatory; all strategy options still complete target, pending cannot be replaced by simpler tree-only scope.
